params.prompt:
Edit this picture. Keep the same 2D anime frame: the same camera position, framing and angle; the same young woman in her early twenties with brown skin and a long dark braid, running from left to right in the same running pose with the same determined face, the same green meadow with a path, the same tall leafy trees behind, the tuft of tall grass and the pond in the foreground (the water shows only soft ripples and sky, no reflection of her); her same size and place in the frame, her shadow on the grass under her, unless the change below says otherwise. There are no logos or lettering in the source; the straw hat's blue band is plain; keep everything plain.
CHANGE ONLY THIS: the flying hat is gone. Along the right side of the meadow runs a grey road, and on it a big plain red single-decker city bus has just pulled away and drives off to the right, seen from the back and side, a few metres ahead of her, large in the frame (at least a quarter of the picture), its doors closed, a small puff of dust behind its wheels. She sprints after it in the same running pose, her arm nearest the camera now stretched forward towards the bus, mouth open as if calling to it, looking at the bus. The bus is completely plain red with dark empty windows: no route number, a blank dark destination window, no number plate, no advertising, no logos, no passengers visible. Must NOT appear: the hat, other runners, a finish tape, a bus stop sign, a village, a futuristic city, her bent over.
Look: keep exactly this style: 2D hand-drawn anime look with thin dark outlines, flat cel colours with one soft shadow tone on the figure, softly painted watercolour-like trees, meadow and sky. Not photoreal, not 3D, not a sketch.
Strictly no text, letters, digits, numbers, signs, speech bubbles, sound words, logos or brand names anywhere. Correct hands with five fingers (or the same simple cartoon hands as the source), each hand holding only what is named; correct arms, legs, paws and wings; no extra limbs. No duplicated characters, no split frame, no collage, no panels, no mirrored copy, no border, nothing floating unless named above; every figure has ground contact or is in a natural running stride. No real person, celebrity or existing cartoon character; nothing scary, no violence, nothing gross. 9:16.
